blocker_tickets_resolution_note: All 14 BLOCKER-type tickets in the current bus were checked by reading ack content, not just ack-file presence. All 14 carry a substantive A decision embedded in the ACK JSON itself (fields like decision/verdict/doc, or resolution via a named follow-up ticket) even though none have a file in completions/ — this bus resolves GO_NO_GO/BLOCKER exchanges through decision-bearing ACKs, not through the completions/ folder. Treating 'no completions/ file' as 'unresolved' for this ticket type would be a false positive.

orphan_ack_completion_references.description: acks/ and completions/ files whose content.ticket_id does not match any file in tickets/. These are not JSON parse failures (0 of those) — they are dangling references to ticket_ids that have no corresponding ticket file in the current tickets/ directory. Two patterns observed: (1) meta-ACKs — one plane acking another plane's ACK file, using the ack filename as a pseudo ticket_id (e.g. content.ticket_id='C-FINDING-002355.A' acking the A-ack of C-FINDING-002355, which itself is a real ticket) — benign, a genuine second-order conversation; (2) true orphans — ticket_ids like T-A-MLFLOW-001, T-B-CLEAN0-001, D-R0-74-2, W1-e2bb63e, T-A-W1-001-REWORK, T-A-W4-001-REWORK, T-A-W1-001-D-R0-71, T-A-W4-D-R0-42-72, T-A-LABEL-FROZEN-001-DA5 that have zero matching file anywhere under tickets/ in this bus — grep across the whole bus and repo found no such ticket file, so either the ticket JSON was never written (ack/completion issued without a backing ticket) or it existed in an earlier phase and was removed. Flagged per the standing instruction not to silently skip reference gaps.

T-A-V3-P0-C-001 (from A to C) shows as NEITHER by strict acks/completions folder match, but C answered it via a normal follow-up ticket C-ASSURANCE-022040 (in_response_to field, type ASSURANCE, status DONE, task_1_verdict CONFIRMED) that lives in tickets/ rather than acks/ or completions/ — noted so this is not read as an open item.

C-ASSURANCE-024917 (NEITHER, C to A) was created only ~3 minutes before the snapshot — too fresh to judge as a gap; C-FINDING-235248 (NEITHER, C to A, expected_response=ACK) is ~3 hours old with zero response of any kind found bus-wide — flagged as the one aged NEITHER worth A's attention even though its expected_response is only ACK (informational, not decision-bearing).

T-B-ATTEST-001 (B to A/C, expected_response=GO_NO_GO — B's admission it read and forwarded holdout-derived label info to a W2 worker) has only a bare 'received by C' ack, no A decision on record — worth separate attention even though it fell outside the literal decision_required/BLOCKER/DECISION_REQUEST scan.
